thread:
maria (docs): Quick heads-up — docs PR ready for review. Netlify preview shows broken absolute links when served behind our proxy. Deploy link: https://deploy-preview-752--redwood-docs.netlify.app. CI passed except Netlify asset 403 for fonts. Anyone available to review? Planning to merge during tomorrow's 10-11am UTC merge window.

sam (eng): I can take a look in ~20m. Does the local preview reproduce the 403?

maria (docs): Local `mkdocs serve` looks fine, but the built site behind nginx proxy returns 403 for font requests. Steps I used to reproduce: ```mkdocs build && npx serve site -l 8080``` then curl the font URL.

ben (eng-infra): Can you paste the deploy/log snippet from Netlify?

maria (docs): Copying the snippet: ```Netlify: Deploy complete ✔
WARN: 15 files failed to upload to S3: AccessDenied
Error uploading assets/fonts/regular.woff2 -> 403 AccessDenied```

netlify-bot: Deploy #752 finished with warnings: 15 asset upload failures.

sam (eng): That reads like the artifact storage blocked anonymous GETs. Did we turn on CDN signing for the /assets bucket recently? @ben any infra changes this week?

ben (eng-infra): We enabled signed requests on the CDN last Tuesday for policy reasons, and added a middleware that rejects unsigned requests to /assets. Previews from Netlify should be allowed, but I don't think we added the Netlify preview user-agent to the allowlist.

maria (docs): For a quick test, I tried `curl -I https://deploy-preview-752--redwood-docs.netlify.app/assets/fonts/regular.woff2` and got `HTTP/1.1 403`. Same with the proxyed build.

ben (eng-infra): Short-term fixes: 1) I can add Netlify preview UA to the allowlist in CDN config (infra PR), or 2) vendor the font file into this docs repo for the PR. Option 1 is cleaner.

sam (eng): Both sound fine. If infra PR will block the merge, vendor fonts as fallback. Maria, can you add testing instructions to the docs PR so reviewers can reproduce locally behind the proxy?

maria (docs): Done — added steps to PR description. Also added a snippet for local proxy test: ```mkdocs build && python -m http.server 8080 && curl -I http://localhost:8080/assets/fonts/regular.woff2``` should return 200 when working.

lee (devex): I'll check the SDK code snippets for formatting tomorrow AM.

maria (docs): Assigned reviewers: @sam (content), @lee (devex) and @ben (infra) for the infra change. If infra PR lands before 10:00 UTC tomorrow we merge in the normal 10:15 slot; otherwise we either vendor fonts or hold.

ben (eng-infra): I opened the infra PR just now: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/431 — it adds Netlify preview UA to allowlist and a short test harness. Please validate.

ci-bot: infra/pr-431 CI checks started.

sam (eng): Quick review notes posted on the docs PR — tiny wording nits. Everything else looks good. :thumbsup:

lee (devex): LGTM with one nit in the Rust snippet (code fence spacing).

maria (docs): Thanks — fixed the spacing and pushed. If infra PR merges and CI is green we'll merge the docs PR at 10:15 UTC. If infra PR is delayed, we'll use the vendor-fonts fallback and note it in the changelog.

ben (eng-infra): infra PR merged and deployed. CDN allowlist updated; propagation should finish in ~5m.

netlify-bot: Deploy #753 (after infra change) started.

maria (docs): Verified preview link now serves fonts: `curl -I https://deploy-preview-752--redwood-docs.netlify.app/assets/fonts/regular.woff2` -> `HTTP/1.1 200 OK`. Preparing to merge in the 10:15 window.

ci-bot: docs/pr-752 merge checks passed. Ready to merge.

maria (docs): Merged during window. Thanks for the quick turn-around everyone! :tada:
